summary_for_children: Al-Waqi'ah means The Inevitable Event. It speaks of a day that will surely come, and asks us to look at the seeds we plant, the water we drink and the fire we light, all from Allah.
environment_concept: A field where seeds are planted (56:63), rain falling into a well (56:69) and a tree with a fire for travellers (56:72).
architecture_and_scenery: A farmer's field, a cloud-fed well and a fire with its tree; a quiet horizon for what is unseen.

palette.lighting: Morning field light, then evening fire glow

areas.name: Field of Seeds
areas.description: A field where seeds are planted.

areas.name: Water from the Clouds
areas.description: Water falling from clouds into a well.

areas.name: Tree of Fire
areas.description: A tree and a fire for travellers.

activities.name: Who grows it?
activities.description: Plant three seeds and watch them grow.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Fresh water
activities.description: Carry three jars of fresh water.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: The Event is spoken of only in ayahs; nothing unseen is shown.
learning_objectives: Explain that the Event is unseen

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (cloud, fire, tree, well) with 2 hands-on activities in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.tier: conceptual for the new engine (an older composed scene exists; not validated as unique)
